evidence.detail: /link/ route exists for users to link their own Discord accounts (login_required, not admin_required)
/admin/unlink/ exists to remove links, but no /admin/link/ exists to create links on behalf of users
Only comment from bakert: 'I think just because they can do it themselves' — acknowledges the gap is intentional by design

triage.notes: This is a design question rather than a bug. The asymmetry (admin can unlink but not link) is by design: users link themselves at /link/. If linking-on-behalf-of is ever needed (e.g. a user can't use OAuth), that would be a separate feature request.
